formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (AB : Line) (CD : Line) (AC : Line) (BD : Line), ((|(a─b)| = |(c─d)| ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD)) ∧ (a ≠ c ∧ a ≠ d ∧ b ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d) ∧ ((Point.sameSide a b CD) ∧ (Point.sameSide c d AB))) → (|(a─c)| = |(b─d)| ∧ ¬(AC.intersectsLine BD))
formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (a b c d : Point) (AB CD : Line) (AC BD : Line) (h1 : |(a─b)| = |(c─d)| ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD)) (h2 : a ≠ c ∧ a ≠ d ∧ b ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d) (h3 : (Point.sameSide a b CD) ∧ (Point.sameSide c d AB)) : |(a─c)| = |(b─d)| ∧ ¬(AC.intersectsLine BD) := by

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (AB : Line) (CD : Line) (AC : Line) (BD : Line), ((formQuadrilateral a b c d AB CD AC BD) ∧ (|(a─b)| = |(c─d)|) ∧ ((AB || CD))) → (|(a─c)| = |(b─d)| ∧ (AC || BD))
formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (a b c d : Point) (AB CD AC BD : Line) (h1 : formQuadrilateral a b c d AB CD AC BD) (h2 : |(a─b)| = |(c─d)|) (h3 : (AB || CD)) : |(a─c)| = |(b─d)| ∧ (AC || BD) := by

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (AB : Line) (CD : Line) (AC : Line) (BD : Line), ((formParallelogram a b d c AB CD AC BD) ∧ ((|(a─b)| = |(c─d)|) ∧ (∟ + ∟ = |(a─b)| / |(a─b)|) ∧ (| (a─b) | = | (c─d) |)) ∧ (Point.sameSide a b AC)) → (|(a─b)| = |(c─d)| ∧ ∟ + ∟ = ∟ + ∟)
formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (a b c d : Point) (AB CD AC BD : Line) (h1 : formParallelogram a b d c AB CD AC BD) (h2 : (|(a─b)| = |(c─d)|) ∧ (∟ + ∟ = |(a─b)| / |(a─b)|) ∧ (| (a─b) | = | (c─d) |)) (h3 : Point.sameSide a b AC) : |(a─b)| = |(c─d)| ∧ ∟ + ∟ = ∟ + ∟ := by

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (AB : Line) (CD : Line), ((|(a─b)| = |(c─d)|) ∧ (AB.parallel CD) ∧ (a ≠ c) ∧ (b ≠ d)) → (|(a─c)| = |(b─d)| ∧ a ⇔ c ⇔ b ⇔ d)
formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (a b c d : Point) (AB CD : Line) (h1 : |(a─b)| = |(c─d)|) (h2 : AB.parallel CD) (h3 : a ≠ c) (h4 : b ≠ d) : |(a─c)| = |(b─d)| ∧ a ⇔ c ⇔ b ⇔ d := by

reference_formalization: ∀ (a b c d : Point) (AB CD AC BD : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a b AB ∧ distinctPointsOnLine c d CD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine a c AC ∧ distinctPointsOnLine b d BD ∧ (a.sameSide c BD) ∧ ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD) ∧ |(a─b)| = |(c─d)| → AC ≠ BD ∧ ¬(AC.intersectsLine BD) ∧ |(a─c)|= |(b─d)|
nl_statement: Straight-lines joining equal and parallel (straight-lines) on the same sides are  themselves also equal and parallel.Let $AB$ and $CD$ be equal and parallel (straight-lines), and let the straight-lines $AC$ and $BD$ join them on the same sides. I say that $AC$ and $BD$ are also equal and parallel. <prf> Thus, straight-lines joining equal and parallel (straight-lines) on the same sides are themselves also equal and parallel.
